title: The Stew Ladle and the Eleventh Bowl
youtube_title: The Stew Ladle and the Eleventh Bowl | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Kei sees that a stew ladle and an eleventh bowl will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Kei makes a smaller, even share so Jasper is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
